description: Defines the interface for PacFileFetcher, an asynchronous component responsible for fetching proxy auto-configuration (PAC) scripts, including methods for initiating fetches, cancelling, and shutdown handling.

classes.name: PacFileFetcher
classes.description: An interface class for fetching PAC scripts asynchronously, with methods for fetch, cancel, and shutdown.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous fetch of the specified PAC URL, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: GetRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext used for downloads, or nullptr if unavailable.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Fails ongoing fetches and prevents future fetches; should be called before shutdown.
